shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
rosette/disc-like small motif (A) vs. no clear counterpart
horizontally banded, register-like organization of incised marks
justification: A depicts a large winged anthropomorphic figure in profile with a horned/tiered headdress, elaborately curled beard and hair, a raised hand and a rosette-bearing wristlet, whereas B shows only dense horizontal lines of small repeated wedge-like signs with no figural imagery at all. The only shared traits are the shallow relief incision and a broadly linear, register-like horizontal organization, which is far too generic to indicate a common depicted subject.
